verses.original: אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּמָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃ וַ֭יַּעַן
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lî·p̄az hat·tê·mā·nî way·yō·mar way·ya·‘an
verses.literal: Then Eliphaz the Temanite . . . replied

verses.original: גָּ֑בֶר יִסְכָּן־ הַלְאֵ֥ל כִּֽי־ מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃ יִסְכֹּ֖ן עָלֵ֣ימוֹ
verses.transliteration: gā·ḇer yis·kān- hal·’êl kî- maś·kîl yis·kōn ‘ā·lê·mōw
verses.literal: Can a man be of use to God Can even a wise man benefit Him

verses.original: הַחֵ֣פֶץ לְ֭שַׁדַּי כִּ֣י תִצְדָּ֑ק וְאִם־ בֶּ֝֗צַע כִּֽי־ דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃ תַתֵּ֥ם
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥê·p̄eṣ lə·šad·day kî ṯiṣ·dāq wə·’im- be·ṣa‘ kî- də·rā·ḵe·ḵā ṯat·têm
verses.literal: Does it delight the Almighty that you are righteous . . . Does He profit if your ways are blameless

verses.original: הֲֽ֭מִיִּרְאָ֣תְךָ יֹכִיחֶ֑ךָ יָב֥וֹא בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃ עִ֝מְּךָ֗
verses.transliteration: hă·mî·yir·’ā·ṯə·ḵā yō·ḵî·ḥe·ḵā yā·ḇō·w bam·miš·pāṭ ‘im·mə·ḵā
verses.literal: Is it for your reverence that He rebukes you and enters into judgment against you

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א רָעָֽתְךָ֣ רַבָּ֑ה לַעֲוֺנֹתֶֽיךָ׃ וְאֵֽין־ קֵ֝֗ץ
verses.transliteration: hă·lō rā·‘ā·ṯə·ḵā rab·bāh la·‘ă·wō·nō·ṯe·ḵā wə·’ên- qêṣ
verses.literal: Is not your wickedness great Are not your iniquities endless . . .

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חִנָּ֑ם תַחְבֹּ֣ל אַחֶ֣יךָ תַּפְשִֽׁיט׃ עֲרוּמִּ֣ים וּבִגְדֵ֖י
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥin·nām ṯaḥ·bōl ’a·ḥe·ḵā tap̄·šîṭ ‘ă·rūm·mîm ū·ḇiḡ·ḏê
verses.literal: For {you} needlessly demanded security from your brothers and deprived the naked of their clothing

verses.original: תַּשְׁקֶ֑ה לֹא־ מַ֭יִם עָיֵ֣ף תִּֽמְנַֽע־ לָֽחֶם׃ וּ֝מֵרָעֵ֗ב
verses.transliteration: taš·qeh lō- ma·yim ‘ā·yêp̄ tim·na‘- lā·ḥem ū·mê·rā·‘êḇ
verses.literal: You gave no water to the weary and withheld food from the famished

verses.original: הָאָ֑רֶץ זְ֭רוֹעַ ל֣וֹ וְאִ֣ישׁ וּנְשׂ֥וּא פָ֝נִ֗ים יֵ֣שֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·reṣ zə·rō·w·a‘ lōw wə·’îš ū·nə·śū p̄ā·nîm yê·šeḇ bāh
verses.literal: while the land belonged to a mighty man and a man of honor lived on it

verses.original: אַ֭לְמָנוֹת שִׁלַּ֣חְתָּ רֵיקָ֑ם וּזְרֹע֖וֹת יְתֹמִ֣ים יְדֻכָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’al·mā·nō·wṯ šil·laḥ·tā rê·qām ū·zə·rō·‘ō·wṯ yə·ṯō·mîm yə·ḏuk·kā
verses.literal: You sent widows away empty-handed and the strength of the fatherless was crushed

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֭ן פַחִ֑ים סְבִיבוֹתֶ֣יךָ פִּתְאֹֽם׃ פַּ֣חַד וִֽ֝יבַהֶלְךָ
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên p̄a·ḥîm sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯe·ḵā piṯ·’ōm pa·ḥaḏ wî·ḇa·hel·ḵā
verses.literal: Therefore . . . snares surround you and sudden peril terrifies you

verses.original: אוֹ־ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ לֹֽא־ תִרְאֶ֑ה וְֽשִׁפְעַת־ מַ֥יִם תְּכַסֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw- ḥō·šeḵ lō- ṯir·’eh wə·šip̄·‘aṯ- ma·yim tə·ḵas·se·kā
verses.literal: - it is so dark you cannot see and a flood of water covers you

verses.original: הֲ‍ֽלֹא־ אֱ֭לוֹהַּ גֹּ֣בַהּ שָׁמָ֑יִם וּרְאֵ֤ה רֹ֖אשׁ כּוֹכָבִ֣ים כִּי־ רָֽמּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hălō- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah gō·ḇah šā·mā·yim ū·rə·’êh rōš kō·w·ḵā·ḇîm kî- rām·mū
verses.literal: Is not God as high as the heavens Look at the highest stars how lofty they are

verses.original: וְֽ֭אָמַרְתָּ מַה־ אֵ֑ל יָּ֣דַֽע יִשְׁפּֽוֹט׃ הַבְעַ֖ד עֲרָפֶ֣ל
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā mah- ’êl yā·ḏa‘ yiš·pō·wṭ haḇ·‘aḏ ‘ă·rā·p̄el
verses.literal: Yet you say What does God know Does He judge through thick darkness

verses.original: עָבִ֣ים סֵֽתֶר־ ל֭וֹ וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶ֑ה יִתְהַלָּֽךְ׃ וְח֥וּג שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ḇîm sê·ṯer- lōw wə·lō yir·’eh yiṯ·hal·lāḵ wə·ḥūḡ šā·ma·yim
verses.literal: Thick clouds veil Him so He does not see us as He traverses the vault of heaven

verses.original: תִּשְׁמֹ֑ר עוֹלָ֣ם הַאֹ֣רַח אֲשֶׁ֖ר אָֽוֶן׃ מְתֵי־ דָּרְכ֣וּ
verses.transliteration: tiš·mōr ‘ō·w·lām ha·’ō·raḥ ’ă·šer ’ā·wen mə·ṯê- dā·rə·ḵū
verses.literal: Will you stay on the ancient path that wicked men have trod

verses.original: אֲשֶֽׁר־ קֻמְּט֥וּ וְלֹא־ עֵ֑ת יְסוֹדָֽם׃ יוּצַ֥ק נָ֝הָ֗ר
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- qum·mə·ṭū wə·lō- ‘êṯ yə·sō·w·ḏām yū·ṣaq nā·hār
verses.literal: They were snatched away before their time and their foundations were swept away by a flood

verses.original: הָאֹמְרִ֣ים לָ֭אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וּמַה־ שַׁדַּ֣י יִּפְעַ֖ל לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ō·mə·rîm lā·’êl sūr mim·men·nū ū·mah- šad·day yip̄·‘al lā·mōw
verses.literal: They said to God Depart from us What can the Almighty do to us

verses.original: וְה֤וּא מִלֵּ֣א בָתֵּיהֶ֣ם ט֑וֹב רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽנִּי׃ וַעֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: wə·hū mil·lê ḇāt·tê·hem ṭō·wḇ rā·ḥă·qāh men·nî wa·‘ă·ṣaṯ rə·šā·‘îm
verses.literal: But it was He who filled their houses with good things so I stay far . . . from the counsel of the wicked

verses.original: צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִרְא֣וּ וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְ֝נָקִ֗י יִלְעַג־ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dî·qîm yir·’ū wə·yiś·mā·ḥū wə·nā·qî yil·‘aḡ- lā·mōw
verses.literal: The righteous see [it] and are glad the innocent mock them

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֣א קִימָ֑נוּ נִכְחַ֣ד אֵֽשׁ׃ אָ֣כְלָה וְ֝יִתְרָ֗ם
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō qî·mā·nū niḵ·ḥaḏ ’êš ’ā·ḵə·lāh wə·yiṯ·rām
verses.literal: Surely . . . our foes are destroyed and fire has consumed their excess

verses.original: הַסְכֶּן־ נָ֣א וּשְׁלם עִמּ֑וֹ בָּ֝הֶ֗ם טוֹבָֽה׃ תְּֽבוֹאַתְךָ֥
verses.transliteration: has·ken- nā ū·šə·lm ‘im·mōw bā·hem ṭō·w·ḇāh tə·ḇō·w·’aṯ·ḵā
verses.literal: Reconcile now and be at peace with Him thereby good will come to you

verses.original: קַח־ נָ֣א תּוֹרָ֑ה מִפִּ֣יו וְשִׂ֥ים אֲ֝מָרָ֗יו בִּלְבָבֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: qaḥ- nā tō·w·rāh mip·pîw wə·śîm ’ă·mā·rāw bil·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā
verses.literal: Receive . . . instruction from His mouth and lay up His words in your heart

verses.original: אִם־ תָּשׁ֣וּב עַד־ שַׁ֭דַּי תִּבָּנֶ֑ה תַּרְחִ֥יק עַ֝וְלָ֗ה מֵאָהֳלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- tā·šūḇ ‘a·ḏō·ša- šad·dai tib·bā·neh tar·ḥîq ‘aw·lāh mê·’ā·ho·le·ḵā
verses.literal: If you return to the Almighty you will be restored If you remove injustice from your tents

verses.original: וְשִׁית־ בָּ֑צֶר עַל־ עָפָ֥ר אוֹפִֽיר׃ וּבְצ֖וּר נְחָלִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: wə·šîṯ- bā·ṣer ‘al- ‘ā·p̄ār ’ō·w·p̄îr ū·ḇə·ṣūr nə·ḥā·lîm
verses.literal: and consign your gold to the dust and the gold of Ophir to the stones of the ravines

verses.original: שַׁדַּ֣י וְהָיָ֣ה בְּצָרֶ֑יךָ תּוֹעָפ֣וֹת וְכֶ֖סֶף לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: šad·day wə·hā·yāh bə·ṣā·re·ḵā tō·w·‘ā·p̄ō·wṯ wə·ḵe·sep̄ lāḵ
verses.literal: then the Almighty will be your gold and the finest silver for you

verses.original: כִּי־ אָ֭ז תִּתְעַנָּ֑ג עַל־ שַׁדַּ֣י וְתִשָּׂ֖א פָּנֶֽיךָ׃ אֶל־ אֱל֣וֹהַּ
verses.transliteration: kî- ’āz tiṯ·‘an·nāḡ ‘al- šad·day wə·ṯiś·śā pā·ne·ḵā ’el- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah
verses.literal: Surely then you will delight in the Almighty and lift up your face to God

verses.original: תַּעְתִּ֣יר אֵ֭לָיו וְיִשְׁמָעֶ֑ךָּ תְשַׁלֵּֽם׃ וּנְדָרֶ֥יךָ
verses.transliteration: ta‘·tîr ’ê·lāw wə·yiš·mā·‘e·kā ṯə·šal·lêm ū·nə·ḏā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: You will pray to Him and He will hear you and you will fulfill your vows

verses.original: וְֽתִגְזַר־ א֭וֹמֶר וְיָ֣קָם לָ֑ךְ אֽוֹר׃ נָ֣גַֽהּ וְעַל־ דְּ֝רָכֶ֗יךָ
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯiḡ·zar- ’ō·w·mer wə·yā·qām lāḵ ’ō·wr nā·ḡah wə·‘al- də·rā·ḵe·ḵā
verses.literal: Your decisions . . . will be carried out and light will shine on your ways

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִ֭שְׁפִּילוּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר גֵּוָ֑ה יוֹשִֽׁעַ׃ וְשַׁ֖ח עֵינַ֣יִם
verses.transliteration: kî- hiš·pî·lū wat·tō·mer gê·wāh yō·wō·ši·a‘ wə·šaḥ ‘ê·na·yim
verses.literal: When men are brought low and you say Lift them up then He will save the lowly . . .

verses.original: יְֽמַלֵּ֥ט אִֽי־ נָקִ֑י וְ֝נִמְלַ֗ט בְּבֹ֣ר כַּפֶּֽיךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: yə·mal·lēṭ ’î- nā·qî wə·nim·laṭ bə·ḇōr kap·pe·ḵā
verses.literal: He will deliver [even] [one who is] not innocent rescuing him through the cleanness of your hands
